binders_in_order.name: hstrong
binders_in_order.type: ∀ x ∈ effectiveDomain f, ∀ y ∈ effectiveDomain f, ∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a → a < 1 → f (a • x + (1 - a) • y) ≤ (a : EReal) * f x + ((1 - a : ℝ) : EReal) * f y - (((lam / 2) * a * (1 - a) * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : EReal)

definitions_and_expansions.SourceProper: (∀ x : E, f x ≠ bottom) ∧ ∃ x : E, ∃ r : ℝ, f x = (r : EReal)
definitions_and_expansions.SourceClosed: ∀ r : ℝ, IsClosed {x : E | f x ≤ (r : EReal)}
definitions_and_expansions.SourceSubdifferential: g is a coordinate-space vector with ∀ u, F(e p) + (inner g (u-e p) embedded in EReal) ≤ F(u)
definitions_and_expansions.hsub: ∃ p : E, ∃ g : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), f p + ((inner g (u - e p) : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ f (e.symm u)

quantifier_scopes.hstrong: x:E, x∈D, y:E, y∈D, a:ℝ, 0<a, a<1, EReal inequality
quantifier_scopes.hsub: existential p, existential Euclidean support vector g, universal Euclidean comparator u
quantifier_scopes.conclusion: unique existential p:E, membership in D and universal comparator q:E

geometry.e: algebraic real linear equivalence; finite-dimensional coordinate identification
geometry.not_assumed: isometry or equality of E norm with coordinate norm

conclusion_scope: global minimization over all E, with a unique finite-valued minimizer
